findings.highlight: The darkness sweeps her body away, and the discomfort jolts her to wakefulness.
findings.evidenceJa: 闇は彼女の体をくまなく浚っていき、その不快感で、彼女の意識は覚醒した。
findings.governingReading: The darkness scouringly passes through/over every part of her and awakens her through discomfort.
findings.explanation: Sweeping every part of her body becomes sweeping the body away.

findings.highlight: I sigh.
findings.evidenceJa: 吐息が漏れる。
findings.governingReading: The viewpoint remains third-person Saber: a breath leaks out.
findings.explanation: Saber’s third-person escaping breath becomes I sigh.

findings.highlight: Saber lays on the ground, looking up at her enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れたまま、セイバーは敵を見上げた。
findings.governingReading: Saber remains prone and cannot remain lying there.
findings.explanation: Intransitive lying is written as lays/lay.

findings.highlight: If he fights something unheard of or incomprehensible, Shirou will be no match for it.
findings.evidenceJa: 相手がそんな、考えもしていなかったモノだとしたら、士郎だけでは太刀打ちできない—
findings.governingReading: If the opponent is this unforeseen kind of thing, Shirou alone cannot handle it.
findings.explanation: An unanticipated opponent becomes unheard-of or incomprehensible opponents.

findings.highlight: It's strangely out of character for him, but the look seems somehow appropriate.
findings.evidenceJa: その顔は常軌を逸しているようでもあり—この上なく、この男に相応しい貌だった。
findings.governingReading: His look seems outside ordinary norms and at the same time supremely fitting for this man.
findings.explanation: Abnormal expression becomes out of character.

findings.highlight: All the world's evil? Hah. It is nowhere near potent enough to contaminate my glorious self!
findings.evidenceJa: この世全ての悪？　は、我を染めたければその三倍は持ってこい！
findings.governingReading: He demands three times the world’s evil if it wants to stain him.
findings.explanation: Bring three times that loses its concrete boast and challenge.

findings.highlight: Listen, Saber. A hero shoulders the weight of all humanity.
findings.evidenceJa: よいかセイバー。英雄とはな、己が視界に入る全ての人間を背負うもの。
findings.governingReading: His definition says a hero shoulders every human entering the hero’s field of vision.
findings.explanation: A hero’s visible human burden becomes all humanity.

findings.highlight: She's simply expressing the tiny warmth still within her heart.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、まだ胸に灯っている小さな温かさを抱きながら、彼女は言った。
findings.governingReading: Clinging to the small remaining warmth, she declares she belongs to her country and is a king before a woman.
findings.explanation: Speaking while holding warmth becomes simply expressing that warmth.

findings.highlight: Honestly. King Arthur...it is no wonder your own country turned on you."
findings.evidenceJa: まったく—アーサー王よ。そんなだから、オマエは国によって滅ぼされたのだ」
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh says her own country brought her to ruin.
findings.explanation: Being destroyed by her country becomes it turning on her.

findings.highlight: Saber stretches her arms out and arrests her fall, then springs upward.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは逆立ちのまま体を反転させ、腕の力だけで大きく跳んだ。
findings.governingReading: Saber reverses her body while inverted and leaps a substantial distance using only her arms.
findings.explanation: The English simplifies an inverted, arm-powered leap into catching a fall and springing upward. This reduces choreography detail without removing Saber's successful resistance.

findings.highlight: The five starting penalties: life, body, imprisonment, humiliation, and finance. Let the myriad sins, mud, darkness, and malice continue to surround and punish all. "Eliminate human rights through decapitation, exile, and repression." "Let the body descend into a state of torment and debauchery." "Eliminate group consensus by forfeiting honor."
findings.evidenceJa: 始まりの刑罰は五種、生命刑、身体刑、自由刑、名誉刑、財産刑、様々な罪と泥と闇と悪意が回り周り続ける刑罰を与えよ『断首、追放、弾圧による人権排除』『肉体を呵責し嗜虐する事の溜飲降下』『名誉栄誉を没収する群
findings.governingReading: The clause describes satisfaction/releasing resentment through tormenting and sadistically abusing a body.
findings.explanation: Sadistic bodily torment’s cathartic satisfaction becomes the body descending into debauchery.

findings.highlight: The five starting penalties: life, body, imprisonment, humiliation, and finance. Let the myriad sins, mud, darkness, and malice continue to surround and punish all. "Eliminate human rights through decapitation, exile, and repression." "Let the body descend into a state of torment and debauchery." "Eliminate group consensus by forfeiting honor."
findings.evidenceJa: 始まりの刑罰は五種、生命刑、身体刑、自由刑、名誉刑、財産刑、様々な罪と泥と闇と悪意が回り周り続ける刑罰を与えよ『断首、追放、弾圧による人権排除』『肉体を呵責し嗜虐する事の溜飲降下』『名誉栄誉を没収する群
findings.governingReading: Across41-42, the clause is annihilation by a collective consensus that confiscates honor and glory.
findings.explanation: Collective extermination that strips honor becomes eliminating group consensus.

findings.highlight: Accidents. Accidents by intoxication. Cover-ups. Crimes for personal gain. Crimes committed in the name of the ego. Crimes committed in the name of love. Crimes committed in the name of virtue. Crimes committed for themselves. Theft and embezzlement, fraudulent cover-ups, contraband,crimecrimecrimecrimehategrudgeattackattackattackdirtydirtydirtyyou'realldirtyatoneatoneatoneatoneciolencecrimesvictimsatoneatoneatone "thisworldisruledbynonhumans." Know your conscience to rectify your sins.
findings.evidenceJa: 事故、飲酒による事故、隠蔽。益を得る為に冒す。己を得る為に冒す。愛を得る為に冒す。徳を得る為に冒す　自分の為に冒す。窃盗罪横領罪詐欺罪隠蔽罪殺人罪器物犯罪犯罪犯罪私怨による攻撃攻撃攻撃攻撃汚い汚い汚い汚いおまえは汚い償え償え償え償え償えあらゆる暴力あらゆる罪状あらゆる被害者から償え償え『この世は、人でない人に支配されている』　罪を正す為の良心を知れ
findings.governingReading: The sequence includes theft, embezzlement, fraud, concealment, murder and property crime.
findings.explanation: The crime list loses murder and adds contraband.

findings.highlight: Accidents. Accidents by intoxication. Cover-ups. Crimes for personal gain. Crimes committed in the name of the ego. Crimes committed in the name of love. Crimes committed in the name of virtue. Crimes committed for themselves. Theft and embezzlement, fraudulent cover-ups, contraband,crimecrimecrimecrimehategrudgeattackattackattackdirtydirtydirtyyou'realldirtyatoneatoneatoneatoneciolencecrimesvictimsatoneatoneatone "thisworldisruledbynonhumans." Know your conscience to rectify your sins.
findings.evidenceJa: 事故、飲酒による事故、隠蔽。益を得る為に冒す。己を得る為に冒す。愛を得る為に冒す。徳を得る為に冒す　自分の為に冒す。窃盗罪横領罪詐欺罪隠蔽罪殺人罪器物犯罪犯罪犯罪私怨による攻撃攻撃攻撃攻撃汚い汚い汚い汚いおまえは汚い償え償え償え償え償えあらゆる暴力あらゆる罪状あらゆる被害者から償え償え『この世は、人でない人に支配されている』　罪を正す為の良心を知れ
findings.governingReading: あらゆる暴力 contributes violence to the collapsing stream.
findings.explanation: Violence is misspelled ciolence in the concatenated accusation.

findings.highlight: I feel the horrible curse crushing all of my senses. Crushing me.
findings.evidenceJa: 五感すべてから注ぎ込まれるモノで潰されていく。
findings.governingReading: He is crushed by what is poured into him through all five senses.
findings.explanation: All five senses as the input route become senses as the crushed target.

findings.highlight: Anyone caught in this darkness wouldn't be able to resist letting it devour them, just from the sheer pain and disgust.
findings.evidenceJa: この闇に捕らわれた者は、苦痛と嫌悪によって自分自身を食い潰す。
findings.governingReading: Those captured consume themselves because of suffering and revulsion.
findings.explanation: The captive devours himself through pain and disgust; English lets the darkness devour him.

findings.highlight: And then in the end, the words of some silly kid lifted a burden from him...and he finally let himself believe that everything would be okay.
findings.evidenceJa: その果てに、つまらない子供が答えたなんでもない言葉に安心して、最期に、良かったなんて頷いたんだ。
findings.governingReading: The child’s ordinary response reassured him, and at the end he nodded that he was glad.
findings.explanation: The father’s relieved gladness becomes confidence that everything would be okay.

findings.highlight: Every breath is like swallowing glass.
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸をする度に気管が裂け、ガラスの破片でも飲んでいるかのよう。
findings.governingReading: Every breath tears the trachea and feels like swallowing shards of glass.
findings.explanation: The tearing windpipe is reduced to the glass-swallowing simile.

findings.highlight: "Shut your damn mouth! I never had a plan in the first place!!!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「うるさい、初めから万策なんて持ってねえ……！」
findings.governingReading: He turns 万策尽きた back on the priest: he never had a multitude of strategies to exhaust.
findings.explanation: Not having a wealth of plans becomes never having a single plan.

findings.highlight: The sheer intensity prevents Saber from using her own Noble Phantasm.
findings.evidenceJa: それを前にして、セイバーは自らの“宝具”を使う事さえままならなかった。
findings.governingReading: She cannot readily use her weapon before that attack; the passage does not name its intensity as the cause.
findings.explanation: Facing the attack with impaired activation becomes intensity preventing activation.

findings.highlight: So she lowers her sword and lets herself sway as if collapsing.
findings.evidenceJa: 振り上げた剣を下げ、倒れ込むように前方へと体を倒す。
findings.governingReading: She lowers her raised sword and inclines her body forward as if falling.
findings.explanation: The deliberate forward body tilt becomes undirected swaying.

findings.highlight: With not a second to lose, she closes the gap between herself and Gilgamesh.
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒すら保つまいというその合間、彼女はギルガメッシュへと間合いを詰め、
findings.governingReading: She closes distance during the brief interval before the cracking barriers would fail in less than a second.
findings.explanation: Barriers unlikely to last even a second become general urgency.

findings.highlight: Searching heat scorches the earth in all directions in a brilliant flash of light.
findings.evidenceJa: 荒れ狂う閃光と灼熱。
findings.governingReading: 荒れ狂う modifies the fierce heat and flash.
findings.explanation: Raging heat is written Searching heat.

findings.highlight: The golden knight draws Ea back, but then sees his enemy's renewed, reckless advance. So he pours yet more magical energy into Ea.
findings.evidenceJa: エアを振り抜き、無謀にも走り寄ろうとした敵を見据え、黄金の騎士はなおエアに魔力を込める。
findings.governingReading: He has swung Ea through, watches her reckless approach and feeds it more power.
findings.explanation: Following through the swing becomes drawing Ea back.

findings.highlight: His legs kick at the air as if swimming. His outstretched arms are swallowed up in the black mud. His vision fails him.
findings.evidenceJa: 前へと進む足は宙を泳ぎ、伸ばした腕は黒い泥に呑まれ、とうに視えなくなっていた。
findings.governingReading: His extended arms have long been swallowed and are no longer visible.
findings.explanation: The arms disappearing from view becomes his vision failing.

findings.highlight: What appears before her is, without question, the sacred sword's sheath.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の目前に放たれ、四散したものは、紛れもなく聖剣の鞘だった。
findings.governingReading: It is released before her and disperses/scatters.
findings.explanation: The sheath’s released scattering is reduced to appearing.

findings.highlight: Saber is protected by the sheath of the sacred sword, and for a moment, she exists apart from all reason and logic in this world.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖剣の鞘に守られたセイバーは、この一瞬のみ、この世の全ての理から断絶される。
findings.governingReading: For this instant, the sheath isolates her from every governing principle/law of this world.
findings.explanation: Separation from the world’s principles becomes separation from reason and logic.

findings.highlight: Avalon. It is the place King Arthur is said to have gone after dying...the utopia the king dreamed of, but could not yet reach.
findings.evidenceJa: アーサー王が死後に辿り着くとされる、彼の王が夢見た、はや辿り着けぬ理想郷—
findings.governingReading: はや辿り着けぬ presents the ideal as now beyond reach.
findings.explanation: The now-unreachable dreamed utopia becomes not yet reachable.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh sees the grim reaper raising its scythe.
findings.evidenceJa: 背筋に走る死神を、ギルガメッシュは確かに見た。
findings.governingReading: The death-god metaphor embodies the fear/chill along his spine that he recognizes.
findings.explanation: Death running down his spine becomes a reaper raising a scythe.

findings.highlight: Before he can leave...
findings.evidenceJa: その前に。
findings.governingReading: その前に refers back to the priest’s turn while Shirou plants his foot and pivots.
findings.explanation: Before the priest’s turn becomes before he can leave.

findings.highlight: The bloody King of Heroes, starts to disappear.
findings.evidenceJa: 血を流し、肉の感触を持っていた英雄王の存在が消えていく。
findings.governingReading: The King’s fading existence is narrated directly.
findings.explanation: A comma separates the subject from its finite verb.

findings.highlight: In the silence that follows...
findings.evidenceJa: その、轟々とした静寂の中で。
findings.governingReading: Kirei speaks within a roaring quiet created by the gust blotting out surrounding sounds.
findings.explanation: Roaring silence during the wind becomes silence after it.

findings.highlight: He takes a deep breath and finally moves, having been motionless from the moment I charged him and impaled him with the blade.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは深く息をつき、ようやく—対峙してから一歩も動かなかった体を、ぐらりと揺らした。
findings.governingReading: His body, which had not moved a step since they faced off, finally sways.
findings.explanation: No step since their confrontation becomes motionlessness only since the stabbing.
